practice.prompt: The system broke because of too much traffic.
practice.answer: The system failure was attributed to excessive traffic load.

answer: This card is testing your understanding of transforming a sentence from active voice to passive voice. In the active voice, the subject (the committee) performs the action (reviewed) on the object (the proposal). In the passive voice, the focus shifts to the object, making it the subject of the sentence, while the original subject can be included with "by" or omitted if it's not necessary. In this case, "The proposal was reviewed by the committee" maintains the original meaning while changing the focus.
